| Character class | Recommended level | Best weapon / spell |
|-----------------|-------------------|---------------------|
| Warrior (or Paladin) | 10–15+ | A **dragon‑slayer sword** (or any heavy blade with a “fire‑bane” enchantment) |
| Mage (or Sorcerer) | 8–12+ | A **fireball** or **flame‑bolt** spell (or a staff that boosts fire damage) |
| Ranger (or Archer) | 9–13+ | A **longbow** with “dragon‑bane” arrows (or a crossbow with fire‑enhanced bolts) |

If you let me know your exact level and the items you have in your inventory, I can call the `game_find_best_weapon` function to give you a precise recommendation.
